title: Volume 1 Chapter 2: 7th Squad Edition 2
content: "I'm sorry for making you accompany me."
"Nei-chan, you're my superior, so just give me orders."
"I thought asking for this kind of favor might be overstepping my bounds."
(You know some difficult words.)
Yuki recalled his memories from when he was in the upper grades of elementary school.
All he could remember was playing innocently with friends.
He thought it was impressive that someone as mature as Nei could be this way at such a young age.
"Um, it feels like everyone's looking at you with a hot gaze, Nei."
"This is a gaze of respect."
"A superior asking their subordinate to sleep beside them?"
There's a legitimate reason for it.
In fact, I respect you for being so serious.
Now, let me give you a massage, okay?
"Yes, please."
Yuki gently and carefully began to massage Nei's body.
"Ahh, it really feels good."
Nei let out a relaxed voice.
And soon, she began to snore softly.
Yuki slowly and quietly left the room, making sure not to wake her.
August 8th.
In the city of Mato, there are no seasons.
However, the weather changes drastically, with sudden heavy rain and significant temperature fluctuations.
Currently, the temperature is thirty degrees, while just a few hours ago, it was nineteen.
Shushu and Himari were out on patrol, while Yuki, Nei, and Kyouka were in the dormitory.
Kyouka was lying in the living room with an eye mask on, taking a break.
The front of the eye mask had the words "Calm Your Mind" written on it.
"It suddenly got hot. I think some people might struggle to adjust their body temperature."
"They say it's tough if you can't adapt to the environment of Mato."
"Are you okay, Nei-chan?"
"It's cool in here."
The dormitory was equipped with air conditioning.
The dormitory connected to the real world through a gate can use electricity and water without any issues thanks to technology and abilities.
"However, we need to be careful of sudden gusts of wind. I almost got blown away once, Nei."
"That sounds scary."
While they were having such a conversation, the outside temperature began to rise again.
"Shushu and Himari seem to be having a tough time."
"They're fine with this temperature."
Kyouka, who was lying down with her eye mask on, interjected.
"You were awake, Kyouka-san. Why not go back to your room and get some proper rest?"
Well, both Nei and you are here in the living room.
Since I'm here, I might as well stay.
Don't worry, I'm resting.
Also, there's no need to hold back in your conversation for my sake.
The voices of my subordinates are surprisingly pleasant.
After saying that in one breath, Kyouka once again began to snore.
"Nei-chan, watch this video. The kittens are so cute."
Yuki showed Nei a soothing animal video.
"Ahh, they're so cute. Cats are animals that the gods worked hard to create as adorable beings, right?"
Yuki also had videos of nature live cameras, but he decided not to recommend those to Nei, as they might contain overly stimulating images.
"They should be back soon. I'll bring out the chilled ramune. Do you want some, Nei-chan?"
"Yes!"
"Mato has no sense of the seasons, so at least we should enjoy something seasonal."
"I'll have some ramune too."
Kyouka had already gotten up.
Then, she playfully picked up Nei and started walking around the dormitory.
In the high-ceilinged area, she held Nei's body in one hand, palm up.
"Ahaha, Nei, this feels like I'm flying!"
It seemed to be one of Kyouka's ways of communicating with Nei.
The sight of Kyouka and Nei playing together occasionally brought Yuki comfort.
However, there were times when he overheard conversations that piqued his interest.
"Nei. Training is indeed important. A well-trained body can respond to any situation."
She was teaching Nei such things, and Nei was listening earnestly.
Would Nei eventually become a martial artist as well?
Yuki didn't know, but it left him feeling a bit complicated.
Eventually, Himari and Shushu returned, drenched in sweat.
"Don't come too close, Yuki! I'm all sweaty!"
"I figured that would be the case, look."
"Ugh! Chilled ramune! You really know me!"
"You're quite considerate. I like this too."
"Himari, even though you're a lady, you love ramen and soda, huh?"
The two were happily drinking ramune.
"It's been a while since I had this, and it's delicious."
Kyouka finished her drink in no time.
"It must be festival season out there."
"Nei, I want to do the bon odori."
"I want to eat yakisoba."
"We can make yakisoba anytime."
"It's delicious because you eat it at those kinds of events."
"I was super good at scooping super balls."
"What’s that?"
"Huh? You don't know about super balls? That's shocking!"
"When I was a kid, I bought a chick at a festival. It grew into a healthy chicken."
"Kyouka-san, you raised a chick?"
"I had to give it away when I transferred schools in middle school, but I still get pictures of it looking healthy."
"Is it still alive? That's amazing!"
"They say those things usually die quickly."
"What? I infused it with spirit!"
"Spirit really is something impressive."
After taking a break, everyone returned to work.
August 9th passed without incident, and everyone was focused on their tasks.
August 10th.
It was the day when the appearance of the special Shuki, Kamairika, was anticipated.
Nei was more focused than ever, scouting the area assigned to the 7th Squad.
"The gate has appeared! Kamairika and about twenty Shuki have emerged there!"
"Good job spotting that, Nei. Himari on patrol is nearby."
Kyouka directed Himari and set out with Yuki.
Receiving the message, Himari arrived at the scene at what could be considered the fastest speed.
"Kamairika is... not here!?"
"That's not good, Himari! It immediately burrowed underground!"
Hearing this from Nei, Himari got angry.
"How cowardly can you be?"
She transformed her arm into a weapon and swiftly wiped out the remaining Shuki.
By the time Kyouka and Yuki arrived, all the Shuki had already been taken care of by Himari.
Kyouka lightly hugged Yuki and patted his head.
"Well, this should be about it for now."
Even so, Yuki felt quite happy.
The 7th Squad was having a meeting in the living room.
"It's good that there were no casualties, but..."
The unsettling part is that while the combat-ready Anti-Demon Corps flee immediately when we approach, they still attack civilian buses, indicating they can judge whether we can fight or not.
"Sounds like a cunning Shuki. But I can be smart too."
Shushu pulled out a map of the area the 7th Squad was responsible for in Mato.
"Look at this, Captain. The emergence points are gradually moving south."
"That's right. That's why I left Himari in place today to predict the emergence location."
"So the next emergence point will be around here on August 13th, right?"
"Yes, do you have a plan, Shushu?"
"We can set up an ambush. Once they appear, we strike immediately."
"If we set an ambush, won't they just appear somewhere else instead?"
"Hehe, Himari, I'm not suggesting we just sit and wait honestly."
Shushu pulled out a feather fan from somewhere.
I'll shrink my body, hide my presence, and wait.
Then, when they appear, I'll immediately grow large and catch them before they can burrow underground—bam!
An ambush!
"You plan to wait alone in a shrunken state in Mato?"
"That's way too dangerous, Shushu-chan."
"Sure, it's thrilling. But we need to take them down soon."
"Understood. Shushu, you've made a good point. I'll commend your courage and idea."
"Leave it to me!"
Let's also have Himari and Yuki lie in wait nearby.
Once Shushu engages, Himari will use the Slave.
With your speed form, you should be able to arrive as reinforcements quickly.
"Understood."
"We also need to consider that Kamairika might not move as expected. In that case, I'll handle it."
This meant that if Kamairika appeared as they anticipated, they would need to take it down without Kyouka.
Himari and Shushu clenched their fists, filled with determination.
"It took less than five seconds from diving into the ground to fully burrowing."
Shushu was gathering various information from Nei, who had seen Kamairika with her clairvoyance ability.
"With five seconds, we could easily catch it before it escapes."
"The physical characteristics haven't changed this time either. It has a head like a hammerhead shark."
"Okay, okay."
"I'm worried about waiting in a small form; it could be small enough to be eaten by a cat."
"There are no cats in Mato, Yuki."
"But the weather can change suddenly, and if a strong gust blows, you could get blown away."
In that case, I'll instantly revert back and dodge.
Yuki, you shouldn't underestimate me in the 7th Squad; I've been trained by the captain.
"I see."
"Yes, the captain approved this plan because she thinks it's feasible."
"Got it. Be careful."
"Actually, I'm more worried about the coordination between myself and Yuki."
Himari arrived.
"I need to rush to Shushu's aid quickly. I'll improve my accuracy during training."
"Yeah, let's do that, Himari."
Himari has the ability to copy others' powers.
She often copied Kyouka's "Slave" to become Yuki's master.
The two left the 7th Squad dormitory while on patrol.
Within the 7th Squad, Yuki and Nei were considered non-combatants, and even if they were in the dormitory, precautions were taken to ensure they were never left alone.
If Nei ended up alone in the dormitory, other squads would be notified, and a support system would be in place to respond immediately if needed.
The same went for Yuki; he was rarely left alone.
If Kyouka wasn't in the dormitory for a meeting and Yuki was there, either Himari or Shushu would be present.
Although there were many cases where combat personnel were resting and sleeping in the dormitory with barriers in place.
In case of an emergency, they could wake up and respond immediately.
Naturally, it was impossible for Yuki to go out alone into Mato.
"Now then, what kind of ramen should we eat tomorrow?"
"More ramen talk?"
"Of course! It's one of the joys of being in the Anti-Demon Corps."
"By the way, what are the other joys?"
"Well, I like sleeping."
"Oh! You just imagined something weird, didn't you? That's naughty."
"Huh!? I wasn't thinking that at all!"
Yuki was surprised, having not imagined anything of the sort.
"I said it before, but isn't it the ones who call things naughty that are actually naughty?"
"Huh? You're the one asking for such rewards, so which mouth is saying that?"
"Hey, isn't the patrol route a bit more to the right?"
"I know that without you telling me."
"Nice handling of the wheel."
"Hehe, even the captain praised me."
Though Himari was a year older than Yuki, due to various circumstances, she didn't use honorifics.
That was also an order from Himari.
Their light banter was a form of communication between the two.
The slave form Yuki transforms into under Himari's command is speed-focused.
Himari trained him to enhance his mobility.
"I'm starting to get tired; at this rate, my transformation will wear off on its own."
"Can't you muster a bit more spirit?"
"I'm saying this after putting in the effort!"
"Oh, you're being rough with your language towards the vice-captain."
"Is it okay for the transformation to forcibly wear off?"
"Fine, I guess I have no choice. I'm going back to the dormitory."
Returning to the dormitory, Yuki reverted his transformation.
Since it was a power copy, of course, rewards were also necessary.
"Come here."
Yuki was pulled by Himari into the bathroom.
Then, in the changing room, Himari kissed Yuki.
While kissing Yuki, Himari began to take off her clothes.
[img]../image/p085.jpg
"Chuu, now you take yours off too, chuu."
The two kissed each other while removing their clothes.
Eventually, when they were both naked, Himari took Yuki's hand and pulled him into the hot spring.
Then, facing Yuki, Himari gazed into his eyes.
Her lips gently brushed against Yuki's nose.
After that, lightly and sweetly, Himari bit Yuki.
"Is wanting to be eaten by me your reward? You're quite complicated, you naughty one."
Saying that, she began to nibble sweetly on Yuki's cheeks and ears.
Kisses rained down on Yuki's entire face.
"But it was a little tasty..."
"That's a scary joke."
"Your voice is a bit shaky."
"I-it's just ticklish, mm!"
Himari's soft lips pressed against Yuki's lips.
As they sweetly kissed, Yuki lost count of how many times their lips met.
Eventually, Himari's tongue invaded his mouth, licking as if savoring him.
As Yuki's hands stiffened, Himari took them and placed them on her body.
While stroking Himari's body, Yuki moved his mouth.
"Mm, aren't you getting better at this? Naughty."
"N-no, you are!"
Yuki's mouth was filled with the taste of Himari's saliva.
